basic_info_description:
Linea was born from the imagination of world-renowned architect Bernardo Fort-Brescia as a way to bring a forward-thinking aesthetic to those who appreciate true modern design. With walls of glass framed by bold, geometric pillars, experience the city's surrounding neighborhoods in luxury and style like no other.

	Professional-Grade Kitchens

All the amenities any chef could expect - from high-end professional appliances and modern, Italian cabinetry to polished quartz countertops and stone backsplashes. The kitchens are designed for large dinner parties or something more intimate

	Walls of Windows

The large, energy-efficient windows let in both the beautiful San Francisco sunshine and the breathtaking views across the city. At night you'll feel the energy of the neighborhood while cocooned in the comfort your own private residence.

	No Detail Overlooked

A lush private courtyard. The Linea Terrace. Residences wired for high-speed internet. And high-end finishes throughout. No detail has been overlooked in the building of Linea. The amenities, architecture, comfort and style work to create the ultimate space for you.

	 Perfectly Located

Hayes Valley's quirky sophistication. Valencia's hip vibe. The Castro's vibrant nightlife. You're right at the center of it all - not to mention easy access to downtown and SOMA, too. Linea is also in a very walkable area of the city, so your options are limitless.

	Modern 

Throughout
Not only is Linea's exterior modern, so is the interior - from upscale appliances and finishes to next-gen CAT-6 wiring and high-speed internet available through AT&T U-verse. It's the ultimate space with both modern aesthetic and functionality
